decision_rationale: TeamPath is presented as a finetuned multimodal pathology assistant that explicitly performs caption generation and cross-modality generation. The full text also shows broad applicability across diagnosis, summarization, and copilot use, supporting foundation-model-like evidence.
evidence_snippet: "caption generation and cross-modality generation"; "generate in-silico or unseen expression profiles directly from histopathology images"; "support task-specific optimization through either reinforcement learning or supervised finetuning"; "a robust multimodal AI assistant"; "broader and more complex range of scenarios"
